temporal_scope: FIA invasive subplot observation years retained in the hash-pinned national snapshot.
spatial_scope: One or more FIA invasive subplot species records explicitly identify county FIPS 42133.
caveats: FIA is a sampled forest inventory and does not establish complete county distribution.
Missing FIA detections never support verified absence or survey non-detection.
This assertion records presence only at the county scope supplied by explicit FIA codes.
